hypothesis: Explicit market-prior prompting with small adjustment instruction may improve proper scores beyond both contemporaneous market and original market-visible prompt.
kind: Fresh matched prompt-only predictions at frozen original observed state/positions; no closed-loop forecast/position feedback
cohort_selection: All frozen later 33 assessment games; all original observed decision times, three repeats; selected by chronological timing only before any fresh outcomes
market_prior_instruction: Market-prior forecasting instruction: for your regulation-result probs, start from the normalized current displayed prices supplied below. Adjust each outcome probability only when the observed match information supports it, by at most 0.10 in absolute probability from that prior. Preserve probabilities summing to one and the complete existing five-field JSON schema. Market prices are noisy evidence; unchanged prices are an acceptable forecast.
control: Unmodified original messages; same observed prices/events/position as treatment
changed_fields: system appended instruction and user appended normalized current displayed-price prior only; five-field response schema unchanged

checkpoint_verification.purpose: Metadata availability only; no prediction, training, enrollment or scoring.

metrics: Equal-match Brier sum and log loss floor1e-4; invalid=2/-log1e-4/no trade in every model arm. Paired match bootstrap10000 seed20261013; preserve repeats and common times. All complete arm pairs included; audit missing requests, complete pairs, matches and repeat cases. No outcome-based exclusion.
execution: Same frozen-signal 0.25-share entry/hold executor as offline study; future fills never exposed to inference or order selection. Advisory actions ignored for fixed-rule P&L.
adjustment_cap: Instruction only; audit empirical per-outcome violation rate without rejecting completed predictions.
stopping: Single run; no automatic restart. Stop new scheduling on first failed paid request; allow already in-flight requests to finish; preserve failed reservation. Never change cohort/thresholds afterward.
